name: Nils Kata sets out
description: After hearing of the death of the ambassador, Nils Kata heads out to the City of Ten Days to find a sky train that can take him to the Northern Trade embassy

name: Nils at the City of Ten Days
description: In the City of Ten Days he encounters a child running from the Wall Diver. The broker of The City of Ten Day's underworld. He smuggles her on his train cart out of the city.

name: Westfort
description: In Westfort Nils Train takes a stop to resupply. He learns of the deteriorating state of the Singer succession wars and resulting shady dealings at the Northern Trade Embassy. The Westfort, an ally is struggling with supplies as its dealing with unrest between the Runners and the Riders.

name: At the Northern Trade Embassy
description: Settling in at the Northern Trade Embassy, Nils Kata begins to unravel its mysteries.
